fields.name: reached
fields.doc: Whether it got there: to the end of its path, within 2 blocks of where it was sent (or of what it went after, which it stops short of); `false` when it gave up.

shapes.name: CentitySpawnOptions
shapes.doc: How `nf.centities.spawn` spawns one. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: temporary
fields.doc: Not saved: its entities aren't kept with their chunk, the server forgets it on a restart, and it's removed when the script that spawned it unloads (a reload of it, or its centity removed), so nothing it made is left behind. What a shot, a damage number or a summoned helper is. `keep()` makes it a normal one. Default `false`.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: Removed this many ticks after it's spawned (its `remove` handlers hear it), loaded or not: at least 1. A centity with a lifetime is temporary too. Default: none.

shapes.name: BodySettings
shapes.doc: A centity's body, as `centity:body()` gives it and `centity:set_body` takes it: the fields of `centity.json`'s `body`, in Lua spelling. Every field is optional to `set_body`. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Blocks across, square: more than 0, at most 16.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Blocks tall: more than 0, at most 32.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Downward acceleration, blocks per second squared.

fields.name: max_fall_speed
fields.doc: The fastest it falls, blocks per second.

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: Fraction of its speed shed per second in the air, 0 to 1.

fields.name: liquid_drag
fields.doc: The same in water or lava.

fields.name: liquid_gravity
fields.doc: How much of its gravity pulls it in water or lava: 0 floats, 1 sinks as in air.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.doc: How fast it reaches its walk on the ground (or flying), blocks per second squared.

fields.name: air_acceleration
fields.doc: The same in the air.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: How fast it slows to a stop on the ground when it isn't walking, blocks per second squared.

fields.name: step_height
fields.doc: The tallest step it walks straight up, blocks.

fields.name: bounce
fields.doc: 0 stops dead against what it hits, 1 bounces off at full speed.

fields.name: fly
fields.doc: No gravity: walking steers it in any direction.

fields.name: blocks
fields.doc: Collides with the world's blocks.

shapes.name: LaunchOptions
shapes.doc: How `centity:launch` flies it. Everything but `velocity` is optional. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: Blocks per second, along the world's axes. Required.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Downward acceleration, blocks per second squared. Default 0: it flies straight.

fields.name: gravity_delay
fields.doc: Ticks it flies straight before gravity takes it, as a thrown knife's first stretch. Default 0.

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: Fraction of its speed shed per second, 0 to 1. Default 0.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: How wide its path is swept for hits, as a sphere's radius in blocks; blocks stop its middle. Default 0.1.

fields.name: pierce
fields.doc: How many hits it goes on through before one ends it. Default 0: the first ends it.

fields.name: rehit
fields.doc: Ticks before it can hit the same thing again. Default: it hits each thing once.

fields.name: hits
fields.doc: What it can hit, as a spatial query's options say (`centities`, `players`, `entities`, `kinds`, `exclude`, `line_of_sight` aside). It never hits itself or its `owner`. Default: everything.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: Who launched it: never hit, and handed to every event. Default none.

fields.name: blocks
fields.doc: Whether blocks stop it (their collision shapes). Default `true`.

fields.name: bounce
fields.doc: Comes off a block instead of ending: the fraction of its speed into the face it keeps, 0 to 1. Default: it doesn't bounce.

fields.name: friction
fields.doc: With `bounce`: the fraction of its speed along the face it keeps, 0 to 1. Default 1.

fields.name: max_bounces
fields.doc: With `bounce`: how many it makes before the next block ends it. Default: no end.

fields.name: rest_speed
fields.doc: With `bounce`: below this speed, blocks per second, after a bounce off a floor it stops and lies there (a grenade) until its `lifetime` is up. Default 1.

fields.name: stick
fields.doc: Sticks in the first block it hits (`stick`) instead of ending: it stays there until its `lifetime` is up. Default `false`.

fields.name: homing
fields.doc: Turns toward the nearest thing it can hit within reach. Default: it doesn't.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: Ticks from launch before it ends (`flight_end`, `"lifetime"`), flying, stuck or lying still. At least 1. Default 600: half a minute.

fields.name: aim
fields.doc: A node that's turned every tick so its +Z points the way it flies (an arrow's nose). Default: none is turned.

fields.name: remove_on_end
fields.doc: Whether it's removed when its flight ends, after `flight_end`. Default `true`.

shapes.name: Homing
shapes.doc: How a projectile seeks: `LaunchOptions.homing`.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: How far it looks, in blocks. Required.

fields.name: turn
fields.doc: The most it turns toward its target, in degrees per second. Default 180.

shapes.name: FlightHitEvent
shapes.doc: A projectile touched something it can hit: `hit`. Exactly one of `target` and `entity` is set.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The projectile.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The centity it hit, or `nil`.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Which of `target`'s nodes (its hitbox), or `nil`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: The player or entity it hit, or `nil`.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Where its middle was when it first touched.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: How fast it was going, blocks per second.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: Who launched it, or `nil`.

shapes.name: FlightBlockEvent
shapes.doc: A projectile met a block it bounces off (`bounce`) or sticks in (`stick`).

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The projectile.

fields.name: block
fields.doc: The block.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Where it met it.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The direction straight out of the face it met.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: How fast it was going into it, blocks per second.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: Who launched it, or `nil`.

shapes.name: FlightEndEvent
shapes.doc: A projectile's flight ended: `flight_end`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The projectile.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why: see `flight_end`.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Where it ended.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: For `"hit"`, the centity it ended on, or `nil`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: For `"hit"`, the player or entity it ended on, or `nil`.

fields.name: block
fields.doc: For `"block"`, the block it ended on, or `nil`.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: For `"block"`, the direction straight out of the face it met, or `nil`.

fields.name: owner
fields.doc: Who launched it, or `nil`.

shapes.name: CentityDamageOptions
shapes.doc: Where damage dealt with `centity:damage` comes from, for its handlers. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Who or what dealt it.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: What kind of damage, in your own words: `"melee"`, `"fire"`.

shapes.name: CentityDamageEvent
shapes.doc: A centity is about to lose health: `damage`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How much it loses: assign to change it.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Who or what dealt it, or `nil`.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: The damage's `cause`, or `nil`.

shapes.name: CentityDeathEvent
shapes.doc: A centity's health reached 0: `death`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: What dealt the last blow, or `nil`.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: The last blow's `cause`, or `nil`.

shapes.name: CentityLandEvent
shapes.doc: A centity's body landed: `land`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: How fast it was falling as it landed, blocks per second.

shapes.name: CentityBumpEvent
shapes.doc: A centity's body ran into something: `bump`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: The direction straight out of the face it hit: `vec3(0, -1, 0)` for a ceiling.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: How fast it was going into it, blocks per second.

shapes.name: Bounds
shapes.doc: A box along the world's axes: `centity:bounds()`.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: Its lowest corner.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Its highest corner.

shapes.name: TouchEvent
shapes.doc: A centity's hitboxes started touching something's: `touch`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity that hears it.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Which of its nodes touched (its hitbox).

fields.name: other
fields.doc: The other centity, or `nil`.

fields.name: other_node
fields.doc: Which of the other centity's nodes it touched, or `nil`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: The player or entity it touched, or `nil`.

shapes.name: StretchOptions
shapes.doc: How `node:stretch_between` lays a node. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Its X and Y scale. Default: as they are.

shapes.name: RopeOptions
shapes.doc: How `node:rope_between` strings a rope. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: How long the rope is, in blocks: shorter than the ends' distance it's taut, longer it sags by its slack. Default: always taut.

shapes.name: TweenOptions
shapes.doc: A tween for `node:tween`: at least one of `translation`, `rotation` and `scale`. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: translation
fields.doc: Where it ends up, as `set_translation` takes.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Degrees, as `set_rotation` takes; not the short way round, so 0 to 360 is a whole turn.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: As `set_scale` takes.

fields.name: ticks
fields.doc: How long, 1 or more (each way, with `back`).

fields.name: easing
fields.doc: `linear`, `ease_in`, `ease_out`, `ease_in_out` or `step`, as keyframes take. Default `ease_in_out`.

fields.name: back
fields.doc: Eases back to where it started after, over as many ticks again. Default `false`.

shapes.name: AnimationOptions
shapes.doc: How `centity:play_animation` plays an animation this time. The file says how it plays by default.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: 1 is as authored (the default), 2 twice as fast, 0.5 half. Not negative.

fields.name: from_tick
fields.doc: Where in the clip to start, in ticks from its beginning. Default 0.

fields.name: loop
fields.doc: `true` loops it whatever its file says; `false` plays it through once (a `hold` clip still holds its last pose). Default: the file's `loop`.

fields.name: blend_ticks
fields.doc: Eases from the pose the nodes have now into the animation over this many ticks, instead of jumping to its first frame. Default 0.

shapes.name: TextStyle
shapes.doc: How a text display draws its text: what `node:display_text_style()` gives and `node:set_display_text_style` takes. Every field is optional; one left out is its default.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: `#AARRGGBB`, alpha first: `"#00000000"` is none at all. Default: Minecraft's translucent grey.

fields.name: opacity
fields.doc: The text's own opacity, 0 to 255. Default 255.

fields.name: shadow
fields.doc: A drop shadow under the text. Default false.

fields.name: alignment
fields.doc: How lines of different lengths line up. Default `"center"`.

fields.name: line_width
fields.doc: How wide a line gets, in pixels, before it wraps. Default 200.

fields.name: see_through
fields.doc: Drawn through blocks in front of it. Default false.

shapes.name: Brightness
shapes.doc: Fixed light levels a display is drawn with: `node:set_brightness`.

fields.name: block_light
fields.doc: Light from blocks (torches, lamps), 0 to 15. Required.

fields.name: sky_light
fields.doc: Light from the sky, 0 to 15. Required.

shapes.name: ActiveBuff
shapes.doc: A buff someone has now: `buffs()`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Its id.

fields.name: ticks
fields.doc: Ticks it has left.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Its file's `name`, or `nil`.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Its file's `icon`, a glyph (`<pack>/<key>`), or `nil`.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Its file's `color`, or `nil`.

fields.name: debuff
fields.doc: Whether it is one.

shapes.name: BuffEvent
shapes.doc: A buff is about to take hold: `buff_add`. Exactly one of `player` and `centity` is set.

fields.name: buff
fields.doc: Its id.

fields.name: ticks
fields.doc: How long it will last: assign to change it (at least 1).

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who gets it, or `nil`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity that gets it, or `nil`.

shapes.name: BuffEndEvent
shapes.doc: A buff ended: `buff_end`. Exactly one of `player` and `centity` is set.

fields.name: buff
fields.doc: Its id.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why: see `buff_end`.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who had it, or `nil`.

fields.name: centity
fields.doc: The centity that had it, or `nil`.

shapes.name: RecipeCraftEvent
shapes.doc: One making of a `station` recipe by `nf.recipes.craft`: `recipe_craft`.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who it was made for.

fields.name: recipe
fields.doc: The recipe's id.

fields.name: result
fields.doc: What this making gives them: the recipe's result, until a handler assigns another.

shapes.name: StationRecipe
shapes.doc: A `station` recipe, as `nf.recipes.available` and `nf.recipes.get` give it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Its id.

fields.name: result
fields.doc: What one making of it gives.

fields.name: materials
fields.doc: What one making of it takes.

fields.name: stations
fields.doc: The blocks that must be near, as its file names them.

fields.name: station_range
fields.doc: How near, in blocks.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: Its `group`, or `nil`.

fields.name: times
fields.doc: `nf.recipes.available`: how many times over the player can make it now. `nil` from `nf.recipes.get`.

shapes.name: RecipeMaterial
shapes.doc: One material of a `station` recipe: exactly one of `item`, `kind` and `tag`, and how many.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: A project item, by id.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: An item id, `"minecraft:stick"`.

fields.name: tag
fields.doc: An item tag, without its `#`.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: How many one making takes.

shapes.name: RecipeAvailableOptions
shapes.doc: What `nf.recipes.available` looks at. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Where its stations are looked for, in the player's world. Default: where they stand.

fields.name: stations
fields.doc: Stations counted as near whatever the blocks are: a menu that is a crafting station, a station item held. Default none.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: Only recipes of this `group`. Default: any.

fields.name: all
fields.doc: Every station recipe, not only those they can make now: one they can't has `times` 0. Default `false`.

shapes.name: RecipeCraftOptions
shapes.doc: How `nf.recipes.craft` makes a recipe. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: times
fields.doc: How many times over, at least 1. Default 1.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Where its stations are looked for. Default: where the player stands.

fields.name: stations
fields.doc: Stations counted as near whatever the blocks are.

shapes.name: ItemViewEvent
shapes.doc: A stack is being sent to one player's game, to be shown as this player alone sees it: `view` on a project item, `item_view` on `nf`.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Whose game it is sent to.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The real stack, as the server keeps it. Changing this table changes nothing: assign `display_name` and `lore`.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: The name this player is shown: the stack's own until a handler assigns another. `nil` for the game's own name.

fields.name: lore
fields.doc: The lore lines this player is shown, the same way. `nil` for none.

shapes.name: ItemRenderEvent
shapes.doc: A stack of a project item is being made, or rewritten to its item's changed file: `render`.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The stack as it is about to be, with its `data` and `count`. Changing this table changes nothing: assign `display_name` and `lore`.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Its name: the file's (or what made it said), until a handler assigns another. `nil` for the game's own name.

fields.name: lore
fields.doc: Its lore lines, the same way. `nil` for none.

shapes.name: SkinParts
shapes.doc: The parts of a skin's outer layer a mannequin shows, each `true` when shown. `mannequin:skin_parts()` gives every one; `set_skin_parts` changes those given.

fields.name: cape
fields.doc: Its cape, when its skin has one.

shapes.name: EntityFilter
shapes.doc: Which entities `world:entities` lists. Every key is optional; an entity is listed when it matches all of those given. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Only this kind: `"minecraft:zombie"`.

fields.name: tag
fields.doc: Only entities with this scoreboard tag.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Only entities within `radius` of this point. Needs `radius`.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: How far from `near`, in blocks. Needs `near`.

fields.name: living
fields.doc: `true`: only living entities (mobs, animals, players); `false`: only the rest.

shapes.name: EntitySpawnOptions
shapes.doc: How `world:spawn_entity` sets up what it spawns, before anything (an `entity_spawn` handler included) sees it. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: custom_name
fields.doc: Its custom name, MiniMessage.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Scoreboard tags to give it.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: A table its `data()` table starts with: the same values a `data()` table may hold. Something that can't be saved is an error.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: How fast it starts moving, in blocks per tick.

shapes.name: EffectOptions
shapes.doc: How a status effect is given. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: amplifier
fields.doc: Its strength above the first: 0 is speed I, 1 speed II. Default 0.

fields.name: ambient
fields.doc: Fainter particles, as from a beacon. Default `false`.

fields.name: particles
fields.doc: Whether it shows particles. Default `true`.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Whether it shows an icon on their screen. Default `true`.

shapes.name: StatusEffect
shapes.doc: One status effect on a living entity: what `living:effects()` lists.

fields.name: effect
fields.doc: Its id: `"minecraft:speed"`.

fields.name: ticks
fields.doc: How long it has left; -1 for ever.

fields.name: amplifier
fields.doc: Its strength above the first: 0 is level I.

fields.name: ambient
fields.doc: Whether its particles are faint, as from a beacon.

fields.name: particles
fields.doc: Whether it shows particles.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Whether it shows an icon.

shapes.name: PathOptions
shapes.doc: How a mob walks where `move_to` sends it. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: How fast, times its own walking speed (its `movement_speed` attribute): 1 walks, 1.5 hurries. More than 0. Default 1.

shapes.name: MobGoal
shapes.doc: One of a mob's goals: what `mob:goals` lists.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: Its key: `"minecraft:random_stroll"` for one of the game's, `"<namespace>:guard_post"` for one the project added, or another plugin's.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Its priority, the game's goals' too: smaller is more important. A goal takes its controls from running goals with a bigger number.

fields.name: controls
fields.doc: What it claims while it runs, so no less important goal claiming the same runs with it: `"move"`, `"look"`, `"jump"`, `"target"` (a targeting goal). Empty for a goal that claims none of these.

fields.name: running
fields.doc: Whether it runs now.

shapes.name: GoalDefinition
shapes.doc: A goal written in Lua, for `mob:add_goal`. Each callback gets the mob. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: How important it is: smaller goes first. A goal takes its controls from running goals with a bigger number, and waits for those with a smaller one or the same. The game's goals use about 0 (swimming up in water) to 8 (looking about).

fields.name: controls
fields.doc: What it claims while it runs, so no less important goal claiming the same runs with it: `"move"` (it walks the mob), `"look"`, `"jump"`, or `"target"` alone (it picks what the mob fights). Default none: it runs alongside the goals that claim something, and one at a time with the others that claim nothing.

fields.name: should_start
fields.doc: Whether to start now, asked every tick or two while it isn't running. Default: always.

fields.name: should_continue
fields.doc: Whether to keep running, asked every tick or two while it runs. Default: what `should_start` says.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: It starts running.

fields.name: tick
fields.doc: While it runs: every tick or two, as the game updates its goals.

fields.name: stop
fields.doc: It stopped: `should_continue` said no, a more important goal took one of its controls, or it was removed while running.

shapes.name: GoalClearOptions
shapes.doc: Which goals `mob:clear_goals` leaves. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: keep
fields.doc: The keys of goals to keep, as `remove_goal` takes them: `{ "float" }` keeps `"minecraft:float"`, so a mob still swims.

shapes.name: AttributeModifier
shapes.doc: One modifier on an entity's attribute: what `living:attribute_modifiers` lists.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Its full id: `"<namespace>:slow_zone"` for one a script added, or the game's own (`"minecraft:sprinting"`), an item's, another plugin's.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How much.

fields.name: operation
fields.doc: How `amount` applies: added; added times the base value; or the total multiplied by `1 + amount`.

shapes.name: TitleOptions
shapes.doc: How long a title takes. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: fade_in
fields.doc: Ticks it takes to appear. Default 10.

fields.name: stay
fields.doc: Ticks it stays. Default 70.

fields.name: fade_out
fields.doc: Ticks it takes to go. Default 20.

shapes.name: EntityDamageEvent
shapes.doc: Something is hurting an entity: heard by the entity, then `nf.on("entity_damage")`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: Who is hurt.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How much, before armour: 2 is one heart. Writable: assign another to change it.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: What hurt it, as Minecraft names it: `"entity_attack"`, `"projectile"`, `"fall"`, `"fire"`, `"lava"`, `"drowning"`, `"void"`, …

fields.name: attacker
fields.doc: Who did it, when someone did: for an arrow, whoever shot it.

shapes.name: EntityDeathEvent
shapes.doc: A living entity died: heard by it, then `nf.on("entity_death")`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: Who died. Its handle answers `nil` from now on.

fields.name: killer
fields.doc: Who killed it, when someone did.

fields.name: drops
fields.doc: What it drops. Writable: assign another list of items (or change this one) to drop those instead.

fields.name: experience
fields.doc: The experience it drops. Writable: assign another to change it.

shapes.name: EntityPathEndEvent
shapes.doc: A mob stopped walking where `move_to` sent it.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: The mob.

fields.name: reached
fields.doc: Whether it got there, within 2 blocks; `false` when it gave up.

shapes.name: PlayerInteractEntityEvent
shapes.doc: A player right-clicked an entity: heard by the entity, then the player, then `nf.on("player_interact_entity")`.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who clicked.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: What they clicked.

fields.name: hand
fields.doc: Which hand the click was with: the game asks for each hand in turn.

shapes.name: EntitySpawnEvent
shapes.doc: An entity is coming into a world: heard by the world, then `nf.on("entity_spawn")`.

fields.name: entity
fields.doc: What's coming. Its methods already work, so a handler can name it or tag it.

fields.name: world
fields.doc: The world it's coming into.

fields.name: cause
fields.doc: What caused it, as Minecraft names it: `"natural"`, `"spawner"`, `"breeding"`, `"command"`, `"custom"` (a plugin or a script), …

shapes.name: BanOptions
shapes.doc: How `player:ban` bans. Every key is optional; a key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: What they're told when they're kicked and when they try to join, as plain text. Default the server's own message.

fields.name: expires
fields.doc: When it runs out, as Unix time in milliseconds (like `nf.server.unix_time()`): a time already past is an error. Default never.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Who banned them, as the ban list shows it. Default `"NetherForge"`.

shapes.name: AdvancementProgress
shapes.doc: How far a player is with an advancement, by its criteria's names as the advancement's own file calls them.

fields.name: done
fields.doc: The criteria they've met.

fields.name: remaining
fields.doc: The criteria left.

shapes.name: BotJoinOptions
shapes.doc: How a bot joins (`nf.bots.join`).

fields.name: skin
fields.doc: Its skin. Without one, it wears one of the game's default skins.

shapes.name: BotWalkOptions
shapes.doc: How a bot walks (`bot:walk_to`).

fields.name: sprint
fields.doc: Sprint there. Default `false`.

fields.name: timeout
fields.doc: Ticks it may take before it gives up, 1 to 500. Default 200.

shapes.name: BotInteractOptions
shapes.doc: How a bot right-clicks (`bot:interact`).

fields.name: off_hand
fields.doc: With what it holds in its off hand. Default `false`.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: A point on it to turn to and click (a square of a board), in the world. Its middle when left out.

shapes.name: Skin
shapes.doc: A skin, as Mojang's session servers sign it: a player profile's `textures` property. Sites that make skins for NPCs (MineSkin, …) give both values.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: The base64 `value` of the `textures` property.

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: Its signature. Players' clients draw an unsigned skin only when the server is in offline mode.

shapes.name: SlotBinding
shapes.doc: What a menu slot shows: `slot:binding()`. A slot of a storage (`storage` and `index`), or what a player wears (`player` and `equipment`).

fields.name: storage
fields.doc: The storage (`player:storage`).

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The storage's slot, from 0.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Whose equipment.

fields.name: equipment
fields.doc: `head`, `chest`, `legs`, `feet` or `off_hand`.

shapes.name: SlotRule
shapes.doc: What a menu slot takes (`slot:set_rule`). A stack goes in when it's any of `items`, `kinds`, `property` or `wearable` (or when none is given), and never more of it than `max`. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The project's items it takes, by id.

fields.name: kinds
fields.doc: The game's items it takes, by id or `#tag` (`#minecraft:head_armor`); a project item's stacks never count as their kind.

fields.name: property
fields.doc: A project item with this key in its `properties` (and not `false`).

fields.name: wearable
fields.doc: What's worn there: `head`, `chest`, `legs`, `feet` or `body`, by its `equipment` slot or, for the game's own items, the slot's armour tag (`#minecraft:head_armor`...).

fields.name: max
fields.doc: The most items it holds: 1 for a ring. Default a full stack.

shapes.name: Item
shapes.doc: An item stack as a plain table: what `menu:item` returns and what `menu:set_item` takes. Only `kind` is required, or `item` instead. Read one, change a field and write it back, and nothing else about it changes: whatever the stack carries that these fields can't say (a book's pages, another plugin's data) rides along in `raw`, which you never write yourself. A field that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The item type: `"minecraft:diamond_sword"`, or `"diamond_sword"`. Required unless `item` names a project item, whose kind it then is; an item read from the server always has it.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The project item (`items/<id>/`) this stack is: `{ item = "ruby", count = 3 }`. Its file fills in every field the table leaves out (`nf.items.create` does the same), and the stack carries the item's namespaced id wherever it goes, so it's still a ruby in a chest, on the ground, or after a restart. A project item the project doesn't have is an error, and so is a `kind` that isn't the item's.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: 1 to 99. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name, MiniMessage. Not italic unless you say so.

fields.name: lore
fields.doc: Lines under the name, each MiniMessage.

fields.name: enchantments
fields.doc: Enchantment id → level: `{ ["minecraft:sharpness"] = 5 }`.

fields.name: glint
fields.doc: The enchanted shimmer without an enchantment, as menus use for "selected".

fields.name: hide_tooltip
fields.doc: No tooltip at all, for filler panes.

fields.name: damage
fields.doc: Durability used: 0 is pristine.

fields.name: item_model
fields.doc: `<pack>/<key>`: an entry of one of your package's resource packs' `items`, or another loaded package's as `<namespace>:<pack>/<key>` ([looks are values](packages.md#looks-are-values)). It names a look the server has, or it's an error; read back, it's as your package writes it.

fields.name: tooltip_style
fields.doc: `<pack>/<key>`: a tooltip frame from one of your package's resource packs, or another loaded package's as `<namespace>:<pack>/<key>` ([looks are values](packages.md#looks-are-values)).

fields.name: equipment
fields.doc: Worn as armour or equipment, drawn as one of the project's resource packs' equipment looks: `{ asset = "gear/ruby", slot = "head" }`.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: `#RRGGBB`, for dyed leather, potions and maps.

fields.name: profile
fields.doc: Whose head, for a player head: a name or a UUID.

fields.name: max_stack_size
fields.doc: How many fit in one stack, 1 to 99, instead of the kind's own. More than 1 on an item that takes damage (a sword, armour) is an error.

fields.name: map
fields.doc: The map a filled map shows, by its number: a screen's (`screen:item`), or any of the game's. Only a `minecraft:filled_map` draws it.

fields.name: rarity
fields.doc: The colour of its name when it has no colour of its own: white, yellow, aqua or light purple.

fields.name: attribute_modifiers
fields.doc: What it changes about whoever wears or holds it: `{ { attribute = "minecraft:attack_damage", amount = 6, operation = "add_value", slot = "main_hand" } }`. These replace the kind's own (a sword's damage) rather than adding to them.

fields.name: can_break
fields.doc: The blocks a player in adventure mode can break with it: the project's by id (`"ruby_ore"`, a package's `"acme:gem_ore"`), the game's with their namespace (`"minecraft:stone"`), `#tags` of blocks (`"#minecraft:logs"`, or one a project datapack defines), or `"*"` for any block: `{ "ruby_ore", "#minecraft:logs" }`. A project block it names that the project doesn't have is an error.

fields.name: can_place_on
fields.doc: The blocks a player in adventure mode can place it on, written as `can_break`'s: `{ "*" }` is anywhere.

fields.name: hidden_tooltip_components
fields.doc: Lines of its tooltip to hide, by the component that draws them: `{ "unbreakable", "attribute_modifiers" }` hides "Unbreakable" and the attribute lines ("+2 Attack Damage"). The components still apply: the item stays unbreakable and keeps its modifiers. Left out shows the tooltip as it is; `{}` shows every line. A value that isn't a line an item can hide is an error, and so is one the server's Minecraft version doesn't have.

fields.name: food
fields.doc: What eating it does. Any item with `food` can be eaten, even one that isn't food: `{ nutrition = 4, saturation = 2.4 }`.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.doc: A cooldown after using it (an ender pearl's): `{ seconds = 2 }`. Items with the same `group` share one.

fields.name: hold
fields.doc: Held down with no end: a right click lasts until the player lets go, never finishes and uses nothing up. Letting go is `player_stop_using_item`, and `event.ticks` says how long it was held: a flail thrown on release, a charge that grows while held. `true` draws nothing (no zoom, no pose); `{ animation = "trident" }` poses the player as that use of the game's does, a knife raised to throw. Read back, it's `true` or that table, as it was given (a hold whose animation is `"none"` reads back `true`). Unless `use_effects` says otherwise, the player keeps their speed and can sprint, whatever the animation. It can't go with `food`, and only works on a kind with no use of its own (`minecraft:stick`, not a bow or a shield). Left clicks don't attack while it's held.

fields.name: use_effects
fields.doc: How a player moves while using it, for any use: a `hold`, eating, a bow drawn, a shield raised. `{ speed_multiplier = 1, can_sprint = true }` lets them eat at a run.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: Your script's own data, saved on the stack itself (its persistent data container), so it goes wherever the item goes: tag a coin with `data = { coin = true }`. A table keyed by strings, holding what a `data()` table may: strings, numbers, booleans, tables of them, `Vec3`s, `Location`s, `Item` tables, and `Player` and `Centity` handles, which come back as the same types. fields.name: raw
fields.doc: Everything else the stack carries, opaque. Present only when the fields above don't say it all. Leave it alone: it's how a read-change-write keeps what you didn't change.

shapes.name: ItemAttributeModifier
shapes.doc: One of an item's `attribute_modifiers`: how much it changes one attribute of whoever wears or holds it.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: A namespaced id telling it apart from the item's other modifiers. Default `"<namespace>:<attribute>_<index>"` (the project's namespace, and its place in the list from 0), which is what you get back when it has that one.

fields.name: attribute
fields.doc: The attribute: `"minecraft:attack_damage"`, `"minecraft:movement_speed"`, `"minecraft:max_health"`, …

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How much.

fields.name: operation
fields.doc: How `amount` applies: added; added times the base value; or the total multiplied by `1 + amount`.

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: Where the item has to be for it to count. Default `"any"`.

shapes.name: ItemFood
shapes.doc: What eating an item does: an `Item`'s `food`.

fields.name: nutrition
fields.doc: Hunger points it restores (a full bar is 20).

fields.name: saturation
fields.doc: Saturation it adds.

fields.name: can_always_eat
fields.doc: Whether it can be eaten when full. Default false.

fields.name: eat_seconds
fields.doc: How long eating it takes. Default 1.6.

shapes.name: ItemEquipment
shapes.doc: What an item looks like worn, and where: an `Item`'s `equipment` (the `equippable` component).

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: `<pack>/<key>`: an equipment look from one of your package's resource packs, or another loaded package's as `<namespace>:<pack>/<key>` ([looks are values](packages.md#looks-are-values)).

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: The slot it is worn in: `"body"` is a horse's or wolf's armour.

shapes.name: ItemCooldown
shapes.doc: A cooldown after using an item: an `Item`'s `cooldown`.

fields.name: seconds
fields.doc: How long, more than 0.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: A namespaced id: items in one group share a cooldown (`player:set_item_cooldown` takes it too). Default: the item's kind.

shapes.name: ItemHold
shapes.doc: A `hold` item that poses the player while it's held: an `Item`'s `hold`, as a table. Everything but the pose is a plain `hold = true`'s.

fields.name: animation
fields.doc: The pose, as one of the game's uses draws it: `"trident"` (arm raised to throw), `"bow"` (both arms out, drawing), `"crossbow"` (both arms, loading), `"block"`, `"spyglass"` (raised to the eye), `"toot_horn"`, `"brush"`, `"spear"` (held low and forward), `"eat"`, `"drink"`, `"bundle"`, or `"none"`. The zoom of a bow and the spyglass's scope are the real items' only. Default `"none"`. A name that isn't one is an error.

shapes.name: ItemUseEffects
shapes.doc: How a player moves while using an item: an `Item`'s `use_effects`. A field left out is the game's default, or on a `hold` item the hold's.

fields.name: speed_multiplier
fields.doc: Their speed while using it, from 0 to 1. Default 0.2, or 1 on a `hold` item.

fields.name: can_sprint
fields.doc: Whether they can sprint while using it. Default false, or true on a `hold` item.

fields.name: interact_vibrations
fields.doc: Whether starting to use it sets off sculk sensors. Default true, or false on a `hold` item.

shapes.name: MenuOpenOptions
shapes.doc: What `player:open_menu` opens a window with.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: Anything at all, handed to the new window: its script reads it with `this:context()`, and every event on the window carries it as `event.context`. It's the very value, kept on the server, so a table can carry handles and functions. A shared menu has one window for everyone, so giving it a context is an error.

shapes.name: DialogOpenOptions
shapes.doc: What `player:open_dialog`, `dialog:open_for` and `dialog:ask` open a dialog with. Everything here is for this one opening: the dialog's file doesn't change, and the next opening starts from it again.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: Anything at all, handed back as `event.context` on every press (and on `close`) of this opening. Kept on the server for this player until the dialog leaves their screen, never sent to them, so it can carry handles and functions.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: What its inputs start at, by input key, instead of the file's `initial`: a string for a text input, the option's `id` for a `single_option`, a number within the range for a `number_range`, `true` or `false` for a `boolean`. An input the dialog doesn't have is an error.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The title for this opening, MiniMessage, instead of the file's.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: Body text for this opening, MiniMessage, by the body element's `key`: a message's text, or an item's description. A key no body element of the dialog has is an error.

shapes.name: MenuEvent
shapes.doc: Someone opened or closed a menu window.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who.

fields.name: menu
fields.doc: The window.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: What the script that opened the window passed along (`player:open_menu(menu, { context = ... })`), the same as `menu:context()`: the very value, not a copy. `nil` when nothing was, and always for a shared window.

shapes.name: MenuClickEvent
shapes.doc: Someone clicked while a menu window was open. A click on one of the window's slots is heard by the slot, then the menu, then `nf.on("menu_click")`; a click anywhere else starts at the menu.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who clicked.

fields.name: menu
fields.doc: The window.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The window's slot that was clicked, or `nil` for a click in the player's own inventory or outside both.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The slot clicked, from 0: in the window when `in_menu` is true, and in the player's own inventory below it otherwise. `nil` for a click outside both.

fields.name: in_menu
fields.doc: Whether the click landed in the window rather than in the player's own inventory below it.

fields.name: click
fields.doc: What kind of click it was. `swap_offhand` is the swap-hands key (F) over a slot: what is in it and what is in the off hand change places.

fields.name: hotbar_index
fields.doc: For `number_key`: the hotbar slot, 0 to 8.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: What was in the slot clicked.

fields.name: cursor_item
fields.doc: What the player was carrying on the cursor.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: What the script that opened the window passed along (`player:open_menu(menu, { context = ... })`), the same as `menu:context()`: the very value, not a copy. `nil` when nothing was, and always for a shared window.

shapes.name: MenuDragEvent
shapes.doc: Someone dragged a stack across slots of a menu window.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who dragged.

fields.name: menu
fields.doc: The window.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: The window's slots the stack is spread over, from 0, in order.

fields.name: own_indices
fields.doc: The slots of the player's own inventory below it the stack is spread over, in order, numbered as `player:inventory()` numbers them.

fields.name: click
fields.doc: `"left"` spreads the stack evenly over the slots, `"right"` puts one in each.

fields.name: cursor_item
fields.doc: The stack being dragged.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: What the script that opened the window passed along (`player:open_menu(menu, { context = ... })`), the same as `menu:context()`: the very value, not a copy. `nil` when nothing was, and always for a shared window.

shapes.name: DialogPressEvent
shapes.doc: Someone pressed a dialog's button: heard by the button, then the dialog, then `nf.on("dialog_press")`.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who pressed it.

fields.name: dialog
fields.doc: The dialog.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The button pressed.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The button's `key`.

fields.name: values
fields.doc: Every input's answer, by its `key`: the text typed, the option's `id`, the slider's number, or a checkbox's `onTrue`/`onFalse` string (`"true"`/`"false"` unless the file says otherwise).

fields.name: context
fields.doc: What the script that opened the dialog passed along for this opening (`player:open_dialog(dialog, { context = ... })`): the very value, not a copy. It's kept on the server, never sent to the player, so it can be anything at all. `nil` when nothing was.

shapes.name: DialogEvent
shapes.doc: Someone left a dialog without pressing a button, or a script closed it.

fields.name: player
fields.doc: Who.

fields.name: dialog
fields.doc: The dialog.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: What the script that opened the dialog passed along for this opening (`player:open_dialog(dialog, { context = ... })`): the very value, not a copy. It's kept on the server, never sent to the player, so it can be anything at all. `nil` when nothing was.

shapes.name: ItemMatch

shapes.name: CommandDefinition
shapes.doc: How `nf.commands.register` describes a command: everything optional. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: One line for the server's help.

fields.name: permission
fields.doc: A permission node the sender needs. On Paper the command (or subcommand) doesn't exist for a player without it: not in tab completion, not when typed. The console has every permission.

fields.name: aliases
fields.doc: Other names for it.

fields.name: arguments
fields.doc: What comes after it, in order. Arguments with a `default` are optional and must come last; a `text` argument takes the rest of the line, so it must be the last one.

fields.name: subcommands
fields.doc: Words that can come next, each with its own arguments, permission and handler: `{ add = { ... }, remove = { ... } }`. Names are lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`. A subcommand wins over an argument when both could take the word.

fields.name: players_only
fields.doc: Refuses the console (and command blocks) with a message, so the handler can count on `event.player`. A subcommand under a `players_only` command is players-only too.

shapes.name: Subcommand
shapes.doc: A word after a command (or after another subcommand) with its own arguments and handler: `/shop give <player>`. A key that isn't one of these is an error.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: One line for the server's help.

fields.name: permission
fields.doc: A permission node the sender needs. On Paper the command (or subcommand) doesn't exist for a player without it: not in tab completion, not when typed. The console has every permission.
